packageRules.description: Auto-merge all updates. This repo just builds the latest images; rollout is gated in the deployment repos

One PR per image per dependency. A dep shared by several images otherwise gets one branch and PR title for all of them: one image's failing build holds the bump for every image, and when a lagging image later reaches a version another image already merged, the reused branch + title trips Renovate's 'automerged previously' brake and the PR never merges (#233, #259, #290)
Disable built-in dockerfile manager for FROM lines with ARG-suffixed tags (custom regex handles these)
Pin Python version for images with upstream compatibility constraints

readaloud-exporter: the EPUB parser stack must match the alignment-map producer's character for character (text offsets index into the text it extracts), so these pins only move deliberately, together with the producer. An auto-merged bump could silently shift every offset.

mcp-proxy images: hold the mcp SDK at 1.x until mcp-proxy supports 2.x (see the comment above MCP_SDK_VERSION in each Dockerfile). Every image that pins MCP_SDK_VERSION must be listed here, or Renovate will propose mcp 2.x for it.

customManagers.description: '# renovate: datasource=X depName=Y [versioning=Z]' directly above 'ARG *_VERSION='. No versioning fallback, so each datasource's default applies (a forced semver fallback rejected docker tags like 3.21 and silently skipped them). An 'ARG *_SHA256=' directly below is captured as the digest, for datasource=github-release-attachments

'# renovate: datasource=github-commits depName=owner/repo branch=B' directly above 'ARG *_COMMIT=<40-char sha>'. github-commits is not a Renovate datasource (these were never updated), so track the branch head through git-refs
